Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to control how many conversations are evaluated with a sampling percentage in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026.

How does this affect me?
Users will be able to set a sampling percentage when creating an evaluation plan. The percentage will determine how many matching conversations are evaluated for quality and coaching.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

message.Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Control how many conversations are evaluated with a sampling percentage
